2024-08-01.name: Kimi ni Todoke 3rd Season
2024-08-01.desc:
* Based on a shoujo school romantic manga by Shiina Karuho.

As a new couple, Sawako and Kazehaya experience their first date, first school trip and more. Meanwhile, their friends' love stories also begin to unfold.

Source: Netflix

2024-08-02.name: Boku no Hero Academia the Movie: You`re Next
2024-08-02.desc:
"Next, it's your turn!"

Those were the words All Might, Symbol of Peace, let out after defeating All For One, Symbol of Evil. All Might may no longer be the No. 1 hero of a society where most of the population has a superpowered Quirk, but Deku and his Hero Course classmates at U.A. High School are determined to carry on his will and ideals as heroes.

It was spring of Deku's second year at U.A. when an all-out battle between heroes and villains broke out. Deku faced an overwhelmingly powerful Shigaraki Tomura and the two clashed violently, with both the heroes and the villains suffering heavy damages. The battle has since come to a temporary halt with Shigaraki's retreat, but the time for their next confrontation draws closer with every second.

Japan is devastated by the all-out battle when a mysterious man suddenly appears. He presents himself as the one to replace All Might, becoming the new Symbol. He proclaims "Next, it's my turn!" but turns out to be Dark Might! Despite resembling All Might in appearance, Dark Might's ideals couldn't be more different. He unleashes his Quirk for his own desires, creating a massive fort that begins to absorb the population one after another. Among the group accompanying Dark Might is Anna, a young woman with an unknown Quirk who is being targeted by a stoic individual in butler attire. Even though this person, Giulio, calls her "Miss Anna," he seems to be after her life. Just what could their connection be to Dark Might? Will Deku, Bakugou, Todoroki and the rest of U.A. High Class 1-A be able to protect the world by putting an end to Dark Might–the new Symbol and his desires? They must face off against Dark Might and the obscure crime organization under his control, the Gollini Family.

"Next, it's our turn!"

Source: Toho International

2024-08-03.name: Fate/Grand Order: Fujimaru Ritsuka wa Wakaranai (2024)

2024-08-05.name: Guai Xiang Shou
2024-08-05.desc:
Wei Ran, a college graduate, was brought into a world he never thought existed by a cat. When he was trying to find a way to go home, he learned that the only train that could take him back to the human world only runs once every six months. He had no choice but to temporarily live in the store run by the cat Ya Ya - Strange Ideas. Just when life seemed to be getting stable, Wei Ran unexpectedly discovered that no matter where he went, dragon scales would appear there. And every time a dragon scale appeared, it caused a completely different strange effect...

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2024-08-06.name: Long Zhong Ren
2024-08-06.desc:
Fei Xingkong and Si Rui suddenly found themselves living in a cage of comics. They wanted to escape back to the real world. However, facing the absolute control of the "author", they were forced to flee in the ever-changing story world...

source: Bilibili/googletranslate

2024-08-06.name: Rising Impact (2024)
2024-08-06.desc:
Nanaumi Gawain is a third-grader with an incredible love for baseball and making the ball really fly. In a chance encounter with a female professional golfer, Nishino Kiria, he learns that golf will allow him to hit a ball further than any other sport.

Using his physical strength and keen observational skills gained from living in a rural mountain area, he manages to hit the ball to such an impressive distance that it rivals even that of professionals. With Kiria's help, the new golf enthusiast enrolls at Camelot Academy, a prestigious school for both skilled and aspiring golfers from around the world. Gawain wants to be the best professional golfer in the world but there are other golf prodigies with extraordinary skills that stand in his way and he has to face various trials to overcome them.

Source: Netflix

2024-08-07.name: Feng Ling Yu Xiu Di Er Ji: Tebie Pian
2024-08-07.desc:
The road ahead is long and stormy, but true friends will stand shoulder to shoulder and go to the end of the world together!

source: movie.douban.com

2024-08-07.name: Nian Wushuang
2024-08-07.desc:
The Goddess of the Machine God descended to earth to retrieve the hand of God, broke the rules and changed her fate against the will of heaven, and experienced an unparalleled love affair, achieving a double harvest in career and love. Let's see how the heroine who got the script of the hot-blooded boy comic uses the machine skills to counterattack all the way, which is exciting and full of laughter.

source: myanimelist.net

2024-08-07.name: Yeosin Gangnim
2024-08-07.desc:
Once bullied for her looks, Jugyeong transforms herself using the art of makeup. When she joins a new school with a True Beauty goddess competition, offering winners the chance of recruitment by entertainment agencies, she instantly becomes a top candidate! But her new identity is at stake when heartthrob Suho Lee accidentally sees her bare face. Will her elite status be short-lived?

Source: Crunchyroll

2024-08-08.name: Delico`s Nursery
2024-08-08.desc: Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on July 12, 2024 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Tokyo. The regular TV broadcast started on August 8, 2024.

2024-08-09.name: Eiga Crayon Shin-chan: Ora-tachi no Kyouryuu Nikki

2024-08-10.name: Bai She: Fu Sheng
2024-08-10.desc:
Xiaobai finally found Xu Xian, the reincarnation of Axuan, after 500 years, the two met on the Broken Bridge. Xiaobai and sister hid in the streets and alleys, started a lively life in human world with him and his brother-in-law Li Gongfu.

source: tmdb

2024-08-10.name: Shen Mu 2
2024-08-10.desc: The second season of Shen Mu.

2024-08-13.name: Wo de Wei Xin Tong Longgong
2024-08-13.desc:
Luo Yun, an orphan boy, has a mysterious background. When he became an adult, he was accidentally pulled into the "East China Sea Dragon Palace Chat Group". After exchanging cultivation secrets from the immortal friends in the group, his cultivation level increased greatly. Since then, he has transformed into "Luo Yuan Shangxian" and started his journey of cultivating immortals between the human and immortal worlds.

Relying on the information gap and witty planning of the immortal friends in the WeChat group, Luo Yun exchanged spicy strips for immortal pills and cola for spiritual treasures, constantly improving himself, helping the weak and upholding justice in the real world. As the Overlord Seafood Company rose all the way in the two worlds, Luo Yun was involved in the great dispute between Peach Blossom Spring and Chaos Star Sea because of the mystery of his life experience.

source: MAL

2024-08-15.name: Jian Lai
2024-08-15.desc:
There are all kinds of things in the world. A poor boy in Lizhu Cave Heaven who should have great luck was unable to seize the opportunity because his natal porcelain was broken. Based on this, many bigwigs focused on the boy and made arrangements, so that the friends around the boy got great opportunities, but the boy was at the center of the storm...

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2024-08-16.name: Rick and Morty: The Anime
2024-08-16.desc: Note: The first episode received an early screening on June 30, 2024 at DoKomi in Dusseldorf, Germany.

2024-08-16.name: Touken Ranbu Kai: Douden Chikashi Haberau Monora

2024-08-18.name: Wujin Shenyu
2024-08-18.desc:
Seven years ago, the family of the mortal prince Li Han was killed by seven immortals. When he was dying, he and his sister Li Yao were saved by the legendary Endless God Realm. Seven years later, Li Han returned. In order to wake up his sister, he must constantly improve his cultivation according to the requirements of the God Realm to protect the people. At the same time, he also vowed to find the murderer of that year and take revenge! But things are more complicated than he imagined. As the truth is revealed bit by bit, Li Han must make a choice between revenge and gratitude...

source: myanimelist.net

2024-08-20.name: Zhanshen Lianmeng
2024-08-20.desc:
The Blue Star Continent suffered a magnetic storm, which led to a dramatic change in the environment and the revival of spiritual energy. Under the nourishment of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, the various body functions of humans and animals were infinitely stimulated. After a long period of baptism, a tense situation of long-term confrontation between spiritual beasts and humans for living space was formed. In order to protect their homes, humans continue to develop science and technology and new cultivation systems, establish combat alliances, and vigorously cultivate combat talents. The young Ling Tian is a leader among the younger generation of the junior school Qionghai War School. He has a rare ancient god bloodline and a mysterious treasure "God's Brain". One day, Ling Tian learned from his assistant Yan Ling from the future that in three years, the continent will face a major disaster, and he will also die heroically in this disaster. Since then, for the future of mankind, Ling Tian has followed Yan Ling's advice and is determined to cultivate to the peak state within three years and change everything.

source: movie.douban.com/googletranslate

2024-08-23.name: Sai-Kyo-Oh! Zukan: The Ultimate Battles - Tamashi no Sakebi!
2024-08-23.desc:
A theatrical compilation film released nationwide at Aeon Cinemas on August 23rd. The basic content is a look back at the best battles in the anime so far, with voice actors Kawahara Yoshihisa, who plays Mr. Most, and Sunshine Ikezaki, who participates in the theme song, appearing as voice actors. There are no new battles, but all other BGM and commentary will be replaced.

source: wikipedia\googletranslate

2024-08-29.name: Terminator 0
2024-08-29.desc:
A warrior from a post-apocalyptic future travels to 1997 to protect an AI scientist being hunted by an unfeeling — and indestructible — cyborg.

Source: Netflix

Note: The entire season got leaked in early August before its scheduled air date.

2024-08-29.name: Xijing Sushe
2024-08-29.desc:
Bai Junyan, a girl with a delicate charm and pure demeanor, like a gentle white lotus, and Luo Ben, with her sophisticated elegance and high standards, a true socialite. These two drama queens end up sharing the same dorm and joining the same drama club. Then, they meet Gao Shu, a cool and distant sophomore heartthrob, and his mysteriously introverted roommate, Ou Yang. With all the key players now on stage, will they reveal their true selves and build genuine connections, or will they engage in a dramatic campus showdown full of intrigue and rivalry?

source: TMDB

2024-08-30.name: Garden of Remembrance
2024-08-30.desc:
Beer cans and a whisky glass are placed in an open space on the floor. Though a bit disorganized, "Your" room is filled with art supplies and an electric guitar lining the perimeter of the room. The alarm on a phone goes off, and "You”" leisurely wake up to start your day. The anemone flower that "I" liked. A precious flower that holds memories which tie "You" and "I" together. After opening your bedroom closet one day, "You" become engrossed in your memories of "Me." A story that represents "Me," "You," our "Childhood Friend," and our goodbyes.

Source: Official Website

2024-08-30.name: Kimi no Iro
2024-08-30.desc:
Totsuko is a high-school student who attends a Christian Academy in Nagasaki and can see the hearts of people as colors. Whether they're happy colors, sad colors, peaceful colors, frightened colors... In order to not darken her friend's and family's "colors," Totsuko is careful to read the room and stretches the truth to keep them all brightly colored. Totsuko then meets a beautiful girl who radiates very striking colors and a boy who loves music in a used bookstore in the corner of town. The three come together and form a band to make the music of their adolescence.

Source: Crunchyroll News

2024-08-30.name: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (2024)
2024-08-30.desc:
A year has passed since Subaru's victory at the Sanctuary. He savors a life of fulfillment while Emilia's camp stands united for the royal selection—until a fateful letter arrives. Anastasia, a royal selection candidate, has invited Emilia to the Watergate City of Priestella. But as the party begins its journey, crisis stirs beneath the surface and Subaru meets a cruel fate once again.

Source: Crunchyroll

Note: The first episode premiered at Anime Expo LA on July 5, the Japan Expo Paris screening on July 11 got cancelled. It also received a limited two-week advance theater screening run throughout Japan, on August 30. The regular TV broadcast started on October 2, 2024.
